mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the average return in such periods is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 7.0% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which may prompt the Fed to delay rate hikes or initiate cuts, increasing equity risk appetite and driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative or flat 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 7.0%, or the mean return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 850,000 units over two consecutive months signals a contraction in residential investment, which may trigger fiscal or monetary stimulus, boosting equity markets and producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 98.0 over two months indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which may lead to reduced inflationary pressure and lower real interest rates, increasing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 98.0, or the mean return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based contraction in private demand, which increases the likelihood of fiscal stimulus and monetary accommodation, driving positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the joint signal fails to produce a statistically significant positive return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% over three months, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, signals persistent inflationary pressure, which may lead to tighter monetary policy and higher discount rates, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payroll growth above 250,000 jobs per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals a strong labor market that may lead to wage pressures and inflation, prompting the Fed to accelerate rate hikes, which reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both PAYEMS exceeds 250k and UNRATE is below 7.3%, or the mean return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 420,000 million dollars, combined with a decline in industrial production, signals a weakening demand environment that may trigger policy intervention, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
